source: Antarctic Treaty Measure 6 (2021) Revised Management Plan ASPA No 105

exposed_baseline.note: Already opened via 2015 ASPA105; not a holdout.

prespecified_source_selection: 2021 ASPA105 official Annex, Adélie Pygoscelis adeliae north-beach subcolony only, exclude emperor fast-ice colonies and skua chick counts
primary_new_outcome: Chronologically latest explicitly dated post-2013/14 *north-beach* Adélie breeding-pair count in the 2021 plan, if any; report actual start-year and observation coverage. Do not replace missing with zero.
secondary_if_aligned: If the same source reports the *south main Cadwalader Beach* breeding-pair count in exactly the same season, compute north proportion of north+south pairs and difference from 2013/14 fraction. If seasons differ, STOP this calculation.

decision_rules.if_no_post2013_north_count: NO_NEW_OUTCOME_SUPPORT; do not claim persistence or collapse

prior_art: Earlier plan dates and cohort support already exposed; this source is neither independent network nor an unknown treatment.
